description: Answer the checkpoint packet wait_job reported as awaiting_input (its {checkpointId} — read the packet FIRST with get_checkpoint and relay the stills + money triple to your human). ONE `body.decision` per gate: 'approve' (proceed; comments allowed — they record as taste without gating), 'revise' (the director revises per your `body.comments` [{anchor: {beatId}|{timecodeMs}, verdict: 'approve'|'revise'|'lock', note}] and/or `body.edits`, then RE-PRESENTS this same gate as a new packet — in-job, no new charge; the brief quote states the included revision cycles, beyond them revise is refused 402), or 'abandon' (end the run — the only terminal refusal). 'lock' freezes an element contractually: the director touching it surfaces as a lock_violation verdict on the next packet. On approve/revise the Director rehydrates its warm box and continues; then wait_job again.

body.description: POST /checkpoints/:id/resume body — the A1 review grammar.

anchor.description: What the comment is about: a plan beat (content gate) or a timecode on the artifact (layout/motion gates).

verdict.description: Per-anchor verdict under the single gate decision. `lock` = contractually frozen — the director touching a locked element is a defect, surfaced as a lock_violation verdict on the next packet (the no-discard machinery).

decision.description: The ONE verdict for this gate (GitHub review grammar). approve = proceed (comments allowed — they record as taste signal without gating); revise = the director revises per comments/edits and RE-PRESENTS this same gate (in-job, no re-meter); abandon = end the run.

edits.description: Your edited stage artifact (the power path). With edits the re-presented packet carries exactly what you supplied; with comments alone the director re-authors scoped by them.
